## [1.5.0-dev.3](https://github.com/Nezumi-2711/morphe-patches/compare/v1.5.0-dev.2...v1.5.0-dev.3) (2026-11-09)

### ✨ New Features

* **zalo:** add hide business box patch ([342b58e](https://github.com/Nezumi-2711/morphe-patches/commit/342b58e15f60aeb960a01512299d1af2b57aa400))

patches.name: Chat heads instead of Android bubbles
patches.description: Use Zalo's overlay chat heads rather than native Android bubbles on Android 11 and newer.

patches.name: Chat reaction picker
patches.description: Allow the enabled chat reaction UI without a matching subscription package.

patches.name: Clone package
patches.description: Install an ARM64 Zalo clone alongside the original with a custom package and app name. Separate accounts are required.

options.description: Unique Android package for this clone. Do not select the stock package.
Name displayed in the launcher and Android app settings.

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Choose a font in Nezumi's Settings for Zalo's text, chat messages, info card, options, and contacts.

patches.name: Custom sounds
patches.description: Choose custom notification and incoming-call sounds in Nezumi's Settings.

patches.name: Drive backup via microG
patches.description: Enable Google Drive photo backup and use microG for Drive accounts and authentication.

patches.name: Hide Business Box in Messages
patches.description: Hide the Business Box row in Messages when enabled in Nezumi Settings.

patches.name: Hide Discovery tab
patches.description: Remove the Discovery tab from Zalo's main navigation.

patches.name: Hide Media Box in Messages
patches.description: Hide the Media Box row in Messages when enabled in Nezumi Settings.

patches.name: Hide delivery receipts
patches.description: Suppress outgoing message delivery ACKs when enabled in Nezumi Settings.

patches.name: Hide read receipts
patches.description: Keep outgoing read receipts private while retaining delivery ACKs when enabled in Nezumi Settings.

patches.name: Hide text typing
patches.description: Hide outgoing text typing in direct and group chats when enabled in Nezumi Settings.

patches.name: Keep recalled messages
patches.description: Keep received messages and locally available photos after another user recalls them, when enabled in Nezumi Settings.

patches.name: Native signature fix
patches.description: Allow Zalo 26.10.02 ARM64 to start after patching and re-signing. ARMv7 is not supported.

patches.name: View online status privately
patches.description: Hide your activity and show confirmed current-online status in the individual chat header when available.
